skeleton-warrior.title: NoEyes removes the glowing eye object
skeleton-warrior.detail: Skeleton_Warrior_Eyes and its Glow material disappear in the derivative; sockets remain dark. Compare original vs NoEyes before approving this actor.

action-figure.title: Eyes were removed in the face texture, not as geometry
action-figure.detail: Open-eye regions were filled with surrounding skin while brows, nose, mouth and lower atlas expressions were preserved. A faint old oval edge can remain up close.

animatronic-creepy.title: Eye anchors are intentionally asymmetric
animatronic-creepy.detail: The left source eye hangs lower and farther forward. Anchors preserve those source positions rather than forcing a mirrored pair.

avian.title: Avian eye normals point strongly sideways
avian.detail: This follows the source anatomy. Do not force a front-facing mirrored normal during EyeRig calibration.

lorekeeper.title: Glasses remain over the EyeRig
lorekeeper.detail: Source eyes are removed but the glasses stay. Judge the EyeRig through the lenses in Front and 3/4.

protagonist-a.title: Glasses remain over the EyeRig
protagonist-a.detail: Source eyes are removed but the glasses stay. Judge the EyeRig through the lenses in Front and 3/4.

monstrosity.title: Left and right eye surroundings differ
monstrosity.detail: The stitched face patch produces different per-eye surrounding colors; keep per-eye cleanup evidence instead of forcing one shared skin sample.

externalIssues.title: Prototype Pete is Legacy/off-roster
externalIssues.detail: Raised eye bumps were removed although the cleanup brief expected none. Decide original vs NoEyes before Legacy EyeRig use.
